einzeiler: Kristen Stewart and Alia Shawkat talk movies, weed, and memories in the Clubhouse.
kurzfassung: Kristen Stewart and Alia Shawkat join Andy Cohen to discuss their new stoner comedy, The Wrong Girls, alongside director Dylan Meyer. The guests play rapid-fire games, test their friendship compatibility, and answer fan questions about their iconic past projects. They also share behind-the-scenes stories ranging from quirky celebrity encounters to unexpected childhood memories.
stichpunkte: Director Dylan Meyer shares the best and worst parts of working with her real-life wife Kristen Stewart.
Alia Shawkat recalls seeing Celine Dion in Las Vegas as her very first concert.
Kristen Stewart reveals that her childhood lawyer of many years officiated her wedding.
The guests play Panic Roommate, choosing which former co-stars they would want to be trapped with.
Alia discusses being mistaken for dating Brad Pitt after meeting him through Spike Jonze.
The duo competes in a BFF compatibility test covering award shows, kissing preferences, and social media etiquette.
Fans ask questions about iconic internet memes and potential reunions for Arrested Development.
Andy Cohen presents his personal top five favorite movies to watch while high.

kapitel.titel: Top Five High Movies and Fan Pranks

clips.hook: Who officiated the wedding instead of Guy Fieri?
clips.text: Instead of a celebrity chef, the couple chose a longtime legal counsel whom the bride has known since early adolescence.

clips.hook: A tabloid cover that made grandma proud
clips.text: An unexpected supermarket magazine cover featuring a famous actor alongside the actress brought great pride to her grandmother.

clips.hook: The host becomes a celebrity hall pass
clips.text: The host jokingly confesses to one of the guests that she serves as his ultimate celebrity exception.

clips.hook: An intense fear of things emerging from holes
clips.text: One of the guests admits to a very specific phobia involving objects or creatures coming out of small openings.

clips.hook: An awkward icebreaker at a Fox party
clips.text: A childhood dare led the young actress to approach the star of a rival television show with a bizarre question about glacial mass.

beschreibung:
Kristen Stewart & Alia Shawkat join host Andy Cohen. Listen to lively debates on everything from the latest drama surrounding your favorite Bravolebrities to what celebrity is making headlines that week live from the WWHL clubhouse.
